description: This file provides low-level system calls and structures for querying CPU features on NetBSD for the ARM64 architecture, including sysctl wrappers, node enumeration, and CPU ID retrieval.

classes.name: sysctlNode
classes.description: Represents a sysctl node with metadata such as flags, name, version, and descriptive fields.

classes.name: aarch64SysctlCPUID
classes.description: Holds CPU identification registers specific to ARM64 architecture on NetBSD.

methods.name: sysctl
methods.description: Performs a sysctl system call with provided MIB and data buffers.

methods.name: sysctlNodes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sysctl nodes below a given MIB.

methods.name: nametomib
methods.description: Converts a string name to a MIB (Management Information Base) array of integers.

methods.name: sysctlCPUID
methods.description: Retrieves CPU identification information for ARM64 CPUs via sysctl.

methods.name: doinit
methods.description: Initializes CPU features by fetching CPU ID and parsing system registers.
